text:
Ravi Desai: Heads up — Aster Labs (midmarket) triggered the "usage-drop-50pct" rule. Trial expires in 12 days. Proposing a "grace pause + microenable" pathway rather than immediate retention discount.

Nia Gomez: quick details? why dropped? any blockers logged?

Ravi Desai: they stalled after trying the API example; error on CSV schema mapping. No billing set. Health score 65 -> 38 over 2 weeks. One onboarding session attended, no follow-up.

Ethan Brooks: 38 = gets attention. What's the microenable play look like?

Ravi Desai: Plan outline: 1) Offer 45-day grace pause (data kept, read-only access) to remove pressure. 2) 30-min focused lab to fix CSV mapping + 1 sample pipeline. 3) Provide 2k token starter credit and a config snippet to avoid the mapping error. 4) Short in-session poll: "Which part blocked you? (CSV / API / UX / Pricing)" 5) Auto escalation if they run 1 successful job -> CSM outreach.

Nia Gomez: longer pause (45) is nice for midmarket. Any risk of long-term ghost accounts? need reactivation nudges.

Ravi Desai: adding cadence: auto-check at 2 days post-lab, 14 days reminder, 35-day pre-expiry alert. Also set a soft reactivation CTA in the portal.

Finance: quick Q — what's the credit amount? approvals?

Ravi Desai: proposing 2000 tokens + standard support. Low-dollar, high-signal. Finance: ok to approve up to 2500 for playbook.

ProductOps-bot: Action required: create "grace_pause" account state and portal CTA. Assigned to @Ethan Brooks.

Ethan Brooks: I can add the portal CTA and the pause flag. Will need a mail template and the GIF walkthrough for CSV mapping.

Nia Gomez: I'll draft two short templates: (A) Pause offer email with Calendly link, (B) Reactivation reminder. Keep tone empathetic and clear.

Ravi Desai: draft snippet: 
```
Hi {{first_name}},
We saw your team hit a snag importing data. We'd like to pause your paid trial for 45 days and keep everything intact while we help finish the import. Book a 30-min lab here: {{calendly_link}}. Reply to this email to accept the pause.
```

Ethan Brooks: also include the config snippet in the booking confirmation so they can try before the session. I'll hook up the portal flow to drop the snippet when `pause_active=true`.

Nia Gomez: poll choices: `CSV schema`, `API auth`, `lack of time`, `pricing`, `other`. We'll capture free text if other.

Ravi Desai: instrumentation: events needed `csv_mapping_fixed`, `first_run_success`, `pause_activated`, `pause_expiry_warning`. Tagging @Ethan and @Finance for wiring.

Ethan Brooks: on it. I'll add events and a dashboard card for the cohort.

Finance: noted — will create a grant flow for token credits and add reporting line item.

Nia Gomez: checklist before sending:
- Email templates (Nia)
- Calendly + snippet (Ethan)
- Pause flag tested (Ethan)
- Credit provisioning (Finance)
- Events wired (Ethan)
- CSM kickoff DM (Ravi)

Ravi Desai: I'll message Aster Labs today with the pause offer and wait for booking. Will post booking time here. :calendar: 

ProductOps-bot: Reminder: add `grace_pause_play` to CS Playbook doc (assigned to Nia Gomez).

Ravi Desai: update 1765000285 — Aster booked lab for Tue 11am. We'll run the microenable and reopen thread with results.
